title: Making Plans
summary: Friends discuss possible weekend plans while considering weather and budgets.

lines.speaker: Tiago
lines.pt: Você já decidiu o que vamos fazer no sábado?
lines.en: Have you decided what we are going to do on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.pt: Ainda não. Eu queria ir à praia, mas a previsão disse que pode chover.
lines.en: Not yet. I wanted to go to the beach, but the forecast said it might rain.

lines.speaker: Tiago
lines.pt: Se chover, podemos visitar o museu novo no centro.
lines.en: If it rains, we can visit the new museum downtown.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Você sabe quanto custa a entrada?
lines.en: Good idea. Do you know how much admission costs?

lines.speaker: Tiago
lines.pt: Acho que custa vinte reais, mas estudantes pagam meia.
lines.en: I think it costs twenty reais, but students pay half price.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.en: Then I'll bring my student ID.

lines.speaker: Tiago
lines.pt: Depois do museu, a gente podia jantar em algum lugar simples.
lines.en: After the museum, we could have dinner somewhere simple.

lines.speaker: Marta
lines.pt: Combinado. Se o tempo melhorar, ainda caminhamos na praça.
lines.en: Agreed. If the weather improves, we'll still walk in the square.

comprehension.question: Why might they not go to the beach?
